people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
translations.bsb: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
translations.kjv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
translations.asv: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son upon the altar?
